editorial:
Imagine stepping back into the early 1960s, where the old way of living is crashing down around a group of wealthy families. You get to follow these upper-class characters as they realize their money and titles can't save them from a changing world. It feels like watching a slow-motion car crash, but in a fancy house with expensive clothes. The vibe is heavy and serious, focusing on how it feels to lose your status and your power while trying to keep a brave face for the public.

You will probably love the acting here because the cast makes the tension feel real. Some parts of the movie move a bit slow, but the emotional payoff at the end makes it worth your time. If you enjoy stories about family secrets and social shifts, you should definitely give this a try. Since it looks so beautiful, you should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the detail. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep this gem forever.
endingExplained: By the end, the main family finally loses their estate after a failed legal battle. The big twist comes when the youngest son reveals he has been secretly working with the new government to sell off the land. Instead of saving the family name, he chooses his own future over old traditions. The movie wraps up with a final shot of the empty mansion, showing that the old world is officially gone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves historical dramas and family conflicts.
